item.title: About
item.description:
About Me

My name is Zékai (Zachary) Lu. You can call me Zachary for short. I am a PhD student in Sociology at McGill University (fast-tracking from MA program since 2024), currently visiting Beijing Normal University (2026). My academic journey began with a Bachelor of Laws in Sociology from Guangzhou University (2019-2023), where I completed an awarded thesis. My Supervisor is Prof. Eran Shor.

Research Areas

  • Medical Sociology: Early-Life Adversity and Health; Health Stratification; Marginalized Population Health and Discrimination; Mental Health and Psychosocial Processes
  • Demography: Fertility Ideals and Low Fertility; Social Attitude Changes; Family and Household Demography; Population Aging and Life-Course Transitions; Cohort Change and Population Dynamics
  • Sociological Methodology: Causal Inference and Sensitivity Analysis; Sequence Analysis; Latent Class and Transition Models; Longitudinal and Within-Person Methods; Machine Learning and Computational Methods

Programming Languages

  • Python (skilled)
  • R (skilled)
  • Stata (skilled)
  • Mplus (skilled)
  • MATLAB and NetLogo
